title: 采购烫金膜前应该怎么打样？

seo.title: 采购烫金膜前应该怎么打样？

content:
## 内容定位

用于独立站 FAQ、阿里国际站询盘、社区自然引流，回答“采购前要怎么测试烫金膜？”“色卡能否代表量产效果？”“打样要提供什么信息？”

## Reddit 英文短评版

Do not approve a foil only from a supplier’s color card.

Test it on the real production substrate. Include fine text, thin lines, solid areas and the actual logo. After stamping, run rub, tape and folding tests. The best-looking fresh sample is not always the best production foil.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

A structured foil test is essential before bulk purchasing.

I would ask the buyer to test with the actual substrate, actual printed or coated surface, real machine and representative artwork. A sample card alone is not enough because adhesion and transfer depend heavily on surface treatment and machine settings.

Recommended test items:

1. Actual substrate

1. Fine text

1. Thin lines

1. Solid block

1. Reverse text

1. Actual logo

1. Tape adhesion test

1. Rub test

1. Folding or creasing test

1. Post-processing test if varnish, lamination or die-cutting follows

The test should record foil grade, temperature, pressure, dwell time, machine speed and failure mode. Without this data, it is difficult to judge whether the problem is foil, substrate or process.

## 知乎中文科普版

采购烫金膜前，不要只看供应商的样册。样册只是颜色参考，不代表你的材料一定能烫好。

正确打样应该包括：

1. 用实际底材。

1. 用实际机器。

1. 用实际图案。

1. 同时测试小字、细线、大面积和反白字。

1. 做胶带测试。

1. 做耐磨测试。

1. 做折痕测试。

1. 如果后续还要上光、覆膜、模切，也要一起测试。

采购烫金膜不要只问“多少钱一卷”，更应该问“这款膜适不适合我的材料、机器和图案”。

## 阿里国际站成交版

Before bulk ordering, we strongly recommend sample testing on your actual production material.

Please send us:

- Substrate type

- Surface treatment

- Machine type

- Stamping temperature range

- Artwork type

- Required color

- Roll width and length

- Final application

We can provide color cards, sample rolls and foil grade recommendations. Testing on the real substrate helps reduce production risk and avoid peeling, missing foil or blurred edges.

## 自然 CTA

We can provide color cards, sample rolls and substrate-based foil recommendations before bulk ordering.
